skill_name: Write a letter to your friend about finding a job.
workflow:
Dear [Friend],

Finding a job can often times be challenging and overwhelming. I want to give you some advice and encouragement to help you succeed. First, it is important to make sure that you are taking the time to research different industries and the qualifications necessary for the positions you are interested in.
